rules.s4-coverage: Every original reference/tuple, promoted output and supplemental source has exactly one canonical record.
rules.s4-pins: Complete source bytes/mode/pin, prior records and protected inputs match.
rules.s4-spans: Each physical reference and dynamic passage matches current pinned source.
rules.s4-inheritance: Existing source/render slot identity and disposition retained, no duplicate rendered diff.
rules.s4-operand: Scalar guard/metadata cannot be admitted by borrowing path context; document identity comparisons stay admitted.
rules.s4-parks: Each parked operation keeps its own blocker and dependency; no ready patch.
rules.s4-retiring-retained: A retiring target cannot preserve on a retained witness.
rules.s4-patches: Whole source-only diff applies at exact pin and rolls back byte-for-byte; packet-only header custody explicit.
rules.s4-greps: Each source patch retains complete literal/escaped test grep evidence and every match decision.
rules.s4-outputs: Sorted unique pinned output metadata; generated candidates/second run remain missing.
rules.s4-receipts: Complete per-family comparisons and honest missing/not-run proof.
rules.s4-carries: All 137 original carries and 165 original pilot ids retained without losing tuples.
rules.s4-lexical: Every whole-file legacy-root occurrence accounted by original ref, prior slot or author-added edge.
rules.s4-review: All admitted occurrences and every rejection/changed source slot in bounded hash-bound exact-window parts.
rules.a-passage-agreement: All pairs of overlapping operation intervals on the same line/passage agree in admission and effective disposition; independent adjacent expressions have distinct source intervals.
rules.b-real-blocker: R12: no boilerplate dependency shared after quoted operands, paths, IDs and line numbers are normalized; copies join their source passage; serialized state rows use their accepted per-file input dependency.
rules.c-render-owner: Every generated source-copy reference/tuple derives its disposition from the exact source owner; a park cites an actually parked source owner.
rules.d-own-operand: Each admitted dynamic tuple has its exact document-yielding sub-expression pathOperand in its pinned passage; every rejection names a closed R5 nonDocumentUse category.
rules.e-retired-successor: Preserved retired decision citations carry a live successorNote with a real heading anchor.
rules.r11-plans-boundary: R11: an operation rooted only in plans/** is rejected as plans-report-artifact; trace pinned declarations and imported constants, not adjacent context.
